citations.title: Tracy A. Robinson

sentences.quote: Tracy Robinson was appointed President and Chief Executive Officer of CN on February 28, 2022 and is responsible for CN's strategic direction and leadership.
sentences.text: Tracy Robinson was appointed President and Chief Executive Officer of Canadian National Railway (CN) on February 28, 2022, and is responsible for the company's strategic direction and leadership.

sentences.quote: She formally took her position as CEO on February 28, 2022, becoming the first female CEO of a Canadian railway.[1]
sentences.text: She succeeded Jean-Jacques Ruest and became the first woman to lead a Canadian railway as CEO.

Before joining CN she was Executive Vice-President of TC Energy, President of Canadian Natural Gas Pipelines and President of Coastal GasLink, and earlier spent 27 years at Canadian Pacific Railway in commercial, finance and operating roles, including General Manager of Transportation Services, Vice President and Treasurer, and Vice President of Marketing and Sales.

sentences.quote: Robinson earned a bachelors of communication at the University of Saskatchewan and a masters of business administration at the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School of Business.
sentences.text: She holds an MBA from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania and a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Saskatchewan.

sentences.quote: She is Chair of the Board of the Business Council of Canada.
sentences.text: She also chairs the board of the Business Council of Canada.

sentences.text: CN named Patrick Whitehead executive vice-president and chief operating officer and Janet Drysdale executive vice-president and chief commercial officer on October 20, 2025, effective immediately, following the departure of Derek Taylor from the company, a change that ended CN's split approach to developing the operating plan, planning the future network and managing day-to-day operations.

sentences.quote: "Janet and Pat are key drivers of CN's efforts to achieve new levels of operational, commercial and customer service excellence. Their proven cross-functional leadership is instrumental in delivering value for our shareholders and customers. I look forward to working closely with them," said Tracy Robinson, President and Chief Executive Officer at CN.
sentences.text: Tracy Robinson, who remains president and chief executive, described the two as "key drivers" of CN's push for operational, commercial and customer service excellence and of value delivery for shareholders and customers.
Subsequent additions include Jamie Lockwood as vice-president, investor relations and special projects in February 2026 and Matthew Hammond as vice-president, engineering in March 2026.
